title: Astronaut Hip-Bone Loss Could Reach 30%
hook: Astronaut hip-bone loss could reach 30 percent.
closing: Long missions require serious bone protection, because floating can quietly weaken the body supporting you.
question: Would this change your Mars plans?

segments.say: Astronaut bone density can fall 1.5 percent monthly. Weightlessness removes the loading that normally keeps bones strong.
Astronaut hip density can fall 2.2 percent monthly. Weight-bearing bones take the hardest hit.
Astronaut hip-bone loss could reach 30 percent without protection. A long mission turns bone care into survival equipment.
